hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.env.example|*.env.sample) exit 0 ;; *.env|*.env.*|*.pem|*.key|*.cert|*secrets.json|*credentials.json) echo "Blocked: $f holds secrets. Ask the user explicitly before editing it." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.css|*.json) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/prettier ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --ignore-unknown --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; case "$f" in src/*|*/src/*) if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/eslint ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; esac; exit 0
